attrs.body:
in0 = load scaled_dot_product_attention_scale[0]
for a0 in 0..32:
    for a1 in 0..1024:
        for a2 in 0..1024:
            for a3 in 0..128:
                in1 = load x0[0, a0, a1, a3]
                in2 = load x1[0, a0, a2, a3]
                f32 v0 = multiply(in1, in2)
                acc1 <- add(acc1, v0) over a3
            v1 = multiply(acc1, in0)
            acc0 <- maximum(acc0, v1) over a2
        for a2 in 0..1024:
            for a5 in 0..128:
                in3 = load x0[0, a0, a1, a5]
                in4 = load x1[0, a0, a2, a5]
                f32 v2 = multiply(in3, in4)
                acc3 <- add(acc3, v2) over a5
            v3 = multiply(acc3, in0)
            v4 = subtract(v3, acc0)
            v5 = exp(v4)
            acc2 <- add(acc2, v5) over a2
        for a6 in 0..128:
            for a7 in 0..1024:
                for a8 in 0..128:
                    in5 = load x0[0, a0, a1, a8]
                    in6 = load x1[0, a0, a7, a8]
                    f32 v6 = multiply(in5, in6)
                    acc5 <- add(acc5, v6) over a8
                v7 = multiply(acc5, in0)
                v8 = subtract(v7, acc0)
                v9 = exp(v8)
                v10 = divide(v9, acc2)
                in7 = load x2[0, a0, a7, a6]
                v11 = multiply(in7, v10)
                acc4 <- add(acc4, v11) over a7
            scaled_dot_product_attention[0, a0, a1, a6] = acc4
